comment: The class is pretty dull because every class consists of a student presentation, and then him lecturing with a PowerPoint. The homework is mainly reading from the textbook (which you don't ever have to do because he'll just summarize it in class) and articles. There are a few essays which involve research and he is a pretty fair grader. Easy to get a B+. He's a really nice guy who wants his students to succeed.

Excellent professor. Very helpful and friendly.  Smart and enthusiastic. Makes class a pleasure to attend and keeps the course on your mind outside of class. This class greatly expanded my knowledge.  Dr. Wang is the man! I would recommend Dr. Wang to anyone interested in IPE.
Tests follow his notes but he is a fairly hard grader.  Very do-able to get a B/B+ without much work

Boring class.  Dr. Wang is really great and a nice person.  For my class: China, Tawain and Hong Kong, he didn't grade papers until the end of the term which was unfair because you didn't know how you were doing.  Lack of discussion and frusterating as a professor.  A REALLY paper intensive class.

Was an easy grader for Comp. Politics, but in this China course, he tends to rip our papers apart. He really knows his stuff when it comes to the course material though, so if you're interested in China, good for you. Shows videos a bit too often, but his lectures are clear. No need to do the lengthy readings if you pay attention in class.
there is no doubt that he is one of the best professors at UR. he likes teaching and helping students, but keep in mind, that he gives tons of readings and assignments.
Knows his stuff.  Entertains different side of the argument.  Cares about students.

The corniest jokes ever. Generally happy guy, but never lectured on anything pertanent to any graded work in the course. Always ran at least five minutes late in class as well. But all and all an average professor.
He is a good prof. overall.  Boring at times, and lots of reading but exams are pretty easy if you pay attention.
Don't miss the new Vincent Wang album, featuring his smash #1 single, "A Whole New World"

He's quite an easy grader, but gives credit where it is due. He's extremely helpful outside of class and very dedicated to what he teaches. Classes are generally engaging but can be a little boring at times. Overall a good choice for any PLSC class.
He is a good teacher.  I took intl relations with him but it was really a course in globalization.  Take a class with him if only to laugh at his godawful jokes.
He is a pretty good teacher and is pretty funny in an awkward way.
